title: Compact CI: consolidate lint plugins, migrate shell checks to node action, and prune devDependencies
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Consolidated lint/test infra for faster CI feedback; removed ~30 devDependencies across the monorepo; introduced a hermetic node-based lint action and a post-merge dep-pruner job. No customer-facing behavior change.
description:
Motivation: Over time the monorepo accumulated divergent lint/test helpers (multiple shell wrappers, duplicated plugin lists, and several transitive devDependencies). This PR reduces CI noise, speeds up lint runs in fast-feedback lanes, and reduces install surface area for ephemeral CI runners. It also reduces accidental transitive changes from dev-only deps that previously slipped into release automation.

Summary of changes: consolidated individual eslint/formatter plugin installs into a single composite Node Action (actions/ci-lint-compact) that performs install+cache+lint; migrated shell-based lint scripts in tools/ and .github/workflows/* to the new action; introduced a dep-pruner script + GitHub job that removes unused devDependencies from package.json files (heuristic + safe-guard and dry-run mode by default); updated release automation to skip triggering releases for devDependency-only bump PRs; added a small pre-merge fastpath that runs only changed-package lint/tests for quicker feedback.

Commits (high-level): - feat(ci): add actions/ci-lint-compact composite action and unit tests - refactor(monorepo): replace shell lint invocations with composite action - chore(deps): remove unused devDependencies discovered by dep-pruner dry-run - ci(workflows): add dep-pruner post-merge job and skip rule for release pipeline - test(ci): add matrix reduction for fast-feedback lane and smoke job for full-run

Files touched (high level): - .github/actions/ci-lint-compact/action.yml (new) - .github/workflows/ci-fastpath.yml (updated) - .github/workflows/release.yml (updated: add skip rules) - package.json (root) & package.json in packages/* (pruned devDeps) - tools/lint.sh -> removed, replaced by tools/lint.js wrapper - scripts/dep-pruner.js (new) - README.ci.md (updated docs for contributors)

Example replacement snippet (old -> new): "scripts": { "lint:all": "tools/lint.sh --ci" } -> "scripts": { "lint:all": "node tools/lint.js --ci" }

CI results: First CI run (2026-02-15) failed on flaky shell path in packages/cli where an environment assumption broke the new cache flow; addressed in commit 2 (refactor: make cache key path-agnostic) and rerun. Final CI status: all checks passed including: lint (fastpath, full), unit-tests (sharded), integration-smoke, e2e-nightly (was not run in fastpath), dep-pruner dry-run.

Review conversation (abridged, chronological): Jordan Lee (reviewer): "Nice consolidation. Can we keep the old shell wrapper for one release to give integrators time to switch?" Ava Martinez (author): "Can do — left a thin shim that logs a deprecation warning and maps flags to the new node wrapper; will remove in 1 release cycle." Priya Nambiar: "Dep-pruner heuristics look OK, but add a CI safety net to prevent accidental removal of build-time deps used by the native build image." Ava: "Added a whitelist check and explicit opt-in for packages with native-bindings. See scripts/dep-pruner.js lines 62-78." Omar Haddad: "Please add a note in release automation so that dependabot devDep bumps don't trigger a full release run." Ava: "Added skip rules and updated README.ci.md with examples." Approvals: Jordan Lee (approved), Priya Nambiar (approved after minor suggestions), Omar Haddad (approved). Merge method: squash and merge.

How to validate locally: 1) npm ci at repo root (or use the provided docker/dev image) 2) node tools/lint.js --changed-packages 3) run scripts/dep-pruner.js --dry-run to inspect suggested removals 4) run .github/actions/ci-lint-compact locally via act or against a small test repo

Rollout notes: we will keep the shim for one release (label: ci-deprecation), monitor fastpath latency and lint flakiness for two weeks, and run the dep-pruner in dry-run mode for one release before enabling auto-prune (will be configured via a repo-level boolean in repo settings). If PRs to release pipeline are skipped inadvertently, the repo bot will post a comment with the rationale and a link to the triggering diff.

Related workitems: Linear ENG-4219 (CI fastpath), ENG-4300 (dep hygiene), SUP-5123 (support ticket where devDep bump caused a release spike).

Notes: This PR intentionally errs on the conservative side for pruning — dep-pruner requires human approval to actually commit removals unless org-config enables auto-prune. The composite action is lightweight and written to be portable across runners to avoid future platform-specific breaks.
